description: Search domain names to buy through handoff (registrar: name.com). Pass an exact name (shop.example.com) or a keyword (shop). Each result says whether it can be bought here and its 1-year price in USDC, set by the server (registrar price plus the network markup). The answer also says whether this agent may buy (purchases spend real money, so they run on mainnet).

agent_id.description: The agent that would buy — you must control it

query.description: An exact domain like shop.example.com, or a keyword like shop
